II. [נָזָה] vb. (dub.) spring, leap (cf. Arabic نَزَا leap, leap up, upon, Thes Frey Prov. Ar. 1, 171. 297; 22, 138; 25, 11);—hence, according to many,
Hiph. Impf. 3 ms. כֵּן יַזֶּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים Is 52:15 so shall he cause to leap (i.e. in joyful surprise, or = startle) many nations; but perhaps crpt.; Che Comm. יַתֵּר in like sense; < יִרְגְּזוּ (for יזהגוים) many shall tremble (v. רגז), GFM JBL 1890, 216 ff. cf. Che Hpt..
